topic.title: Writer Helper Add-on (Experimental)
topic.shortdesc: The Writer Helper add-on helps technical writers review content, find similar content, listen to content, and discover editing tips.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
body.p: offers an add-on that provides support for helping technical writers review content, find similar content, listen to content, discover editing tips, and more. Once the add-on is installed, a Writer Helper view is available from the Window Show View menu. Once opened, you can use one of its available tabs to access the functionality.
